Thanks again for continued interest in Redwood Dedicated/Private. We want to run a short technical + security stakeholder demo focused on deployment options, data controls, and audit artifacts. - Note DST transitions in July: EU (CEST) will be UTC+2; APAC calendars are stable but we want to avoid very early mornings for EU reviewers.

Proposed slots (all durations 45-60m):
- Option A (single global): Tue 2026-07-07 14:00 UTC / 16:00 CEST / 23:00 JST - ok for APAC?
- Option B (EU-focused): Wed 2026-07-08 09:30 CEST / 07:30 UTC - EU DPO-friendly morning

Attached: a draft agenda and a short security questionnaire to prioritize what to cover. Neha and Vivek from our side are looped for handoffs and technical depth.

If it helps, we can split into two 30-45m sessions (EU only / APAC only) to avoid painful crossover times.

Thanks,
